{{Quote|The bounty hunter who swindled ''Sli Genchu'' out of the ''Lodan'' job? Word is he's waiting for you back on ''Coruscant''.|[[Volan Das/Legends|Volan Das]], to [[Arlain Zee]]|<ref name="Lockdown (comic)">{{TCWComicCite|6.47|Lockdown (comic story)}}</ref>}}
'''Sli Genchu''' was an individual who operated on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] around the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. At some point, the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Arlain Zee]] earned notoriety and became a wanted man after he swindled Genchu out of the proceeds of the [[Lodan job]].<ref name="Lockdown (comic)" />
